name: trycua/cua
title: Hands-on test of 16 agent browser and computer-use tools on one Apple Silicon Mac: cua-driver plus Ardia or OpenCode Browse win on speed, RAM and tokens
summary: Matt Van Horn timed 16 browser and Mac computer-use tools on the same five targets; cua-driver drove native apps in the background at about 27 MB RAM, and OpenCode Browse produced page snapshots 53x smaller than Stagehand while avoiding Chrome's remote-debugging prompts. Useful for anyone picking a browser layer for local coding agents.

appearances.title: Cua Driver Bench measures background desktop agents that leave you undisturbed
appearances.summary: Cua and Scale AI AgentEnv launched Cua Driver Bench for desktop agents that must work in the background without stealing focus. On macOS they report Cua Driver fully passing 58% versus Codex computer use 33%, Vercel agent-desktop 20%, and browser-use 3%, with a write-up, HF space, and dataset.
